parsed_json.up: Select molecules reported in the specified document. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and to compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1821609. Return molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name (pref_name), max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
